name: Do I need to turn off my main water supply during a small plumbing renovation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to turn off my main water supply during a small plumbing renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most small plumbing renovations, such as replacing a faucet or toilet, you will need to turn off the main water supply to prevent flooding and allow for safe installation. Some fixtures may have local shut-off valves, which can isolate the water without affecting the rest of the house. However, it's always safest to know the location of your main shut-off valve. As a first-party insight, CG Plumbing Solutions always verifies water shut-off points before starting any work to ensure minimal disruption and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, for most small plumbing renovations, you need to turn off the main water supply or use local shut-off valves to ensure safety. CG Plumbing Solutions verifies this before starting work.
